items.definition:
not causing surprise
It was unsurprising that he won the competition.

causing annoyance, trouble, or worry
The constant noise from the construction site was bothersome.

silly or foolish; sluggish or drowsy
He felt a bit dopey after taking the cold medicine.

fine; excellent; pleasant (informal, somewhat dated)
Everything's just ducky, thanks for asking.

Able to be folded flat or into a smaller shape.
We bought a collapsible table for camping.

Refusing to obey rules or someone in authority.
The disobedient child refused to go to bed.

full of flavor; tasty
This soup is very flavorful.

nervous and easily startled
She felt jumpy after watching the horror movie.

Able to be recycled.
This packaging is fully recyclable.

Having plenty of room; spacious.
The new car is very roomy inside.

able to be cured
Many diseases are now curable with modern medicine.

rough or husky in voice
After shouting at the concert, her voice was hoarse.

Having a shape like a box; square and plain.
The old car had a very boxy design compared to modern vehicles.

relaxed and tolerant in attitude or manner
He has a very easygoing personality.

somewhat grey
The sky had a dull, greyish color.

having eight sides
The table had an octagonal shape.

not hurt or harmed
Despite the accident, she was miraculously uninjured.

covered with moss
The old stone wall was covered in a thick, mossy growth.

having a strong, sharp taste or smell
The lemon pie had a delicious tangy flavor.

not amusing; dull
His jokes were completely unfunny.

not required or necessary
All the extra paperwork was unneeded.

lit by the moon
They walked along the moonlit path.

producing little or no smoke
They installed a new smokeless fireplace in the living room.

intelligent or intellectual
She's a very brainy student and always gets top grades.

preserved in or coated with sugar
She made candied pecans for the holiday dessert.

able to be folded
I bought a new foldable chair for camping.

somewhat gray
The sky had a grayish tint before the storm.

not polite; rude
It's impolite to interrupt someone while they are speaking.

difficult or impossible to read
The old manuscript was almost unreadable.

relating to Guinea or its people
The Guinean delegation arrived for the summit.

having many colors
The parrot had beautiful multicolored feathers.

not neat or orderly
Her room was always untidy.

able to be used
The old computer is still useable.

able to be washed
This fabric is washable, so it's easy to care for.

like a father; characteristic of a father
He offered some fatherly advice to the young man.

in small, tight curls
After the rain, her hair became very frizzy.

stimulating the appetite; appealing
The aroma of the freshly baked bread was very appetizing.

safe or suitable for drinking
The water from the tap is drinkable in most cities.

irritable and bad-tempered
He's always a bit grouchy before his first cup of coffee.

characterized by gusts of wind
It was a cold and gusty day, perfect for flying a kite.

tiny; very small
She found an itty-bitty spider crawling on her hand.

not showing sympathy or concern
His uncaring attitude upset everyone.

not cooked enough
The chicken was a bit undercooked.

slightly open
The door was left ajar.

having the form of a half circle
The table had a semicircular shape.

without words; silent
She gave a wordless nod of agreement.
